question: Which Indian monument was the most visited monument by domestic tourists in financial year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taj Mahal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most visited monument** by **domestic tourists** in financial year **2022 **is the **Taj Mahal,** which is located in **Agra, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The Taj Mahal was built by **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan **in memory of his beloved wife **Mumtaz Maha**l and is considered one of the **Seven Wonders of the World.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Humayun's Tomb,** located in **Delhi, **is another popular monument that attracts a large number of tourists.

 
 
• It was built in the **16th century** and is considered a** precursor to the Taj Mahal **in terms of architectural style.
 
 
 
• The **Red Fort of Delhi**, also known as **Lal Qila,** is a **historic fort complex** that served as the residence of the **Mughal Emperors** for nearly **200 years.**
 
 
• It is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site **and is known for its intricate design and beautiful architecture.
 
 
 
• **Qutub Minar,** located in **Delhi,** is a towering minaret built in the **12th century.**
 
 
• It is considered a masterpiece of** Mughal architecture** and is a popular tourist attraction in Delhi.
 
 
 
• Hence, the** correct option** for the question is 2) Taj Mahal.
